author: HeroMagnetic
quote:
Jesus Christ. Is this a joke? Who made this game?

I’m shocked. This isn’t GTA. It feels like a completely different game. 0/10. 30 fps in 2026. The story is boring. The characters are so weird and uninteresting. I uninstalled the game. I shouldn’t have purchased, and I will never touch it again. It’s so terrible. Nothing is good from it. I see some people say, well the graphics are good! Is it? I don’t see it, really.. It truly hurts knowing this is the outcome after a 13 year wait. I don’t know who wrote this story and made the game in general. I just want to give some advice: please fire your developers. Because whoever wrote this story, should never touch a video game again. Thanks. 0/10.
